title: SEVERANCE x Mall World
content: Watching *Severance* and I am floored by how much it feels like staring into the Mall World. These are examples of the Severed Floor, but even the neighborhoods and exteriors of the Lumon building scream Mall World to me. First, anyone else watching this show and seeing what I'm seeing? Second, who on the staff of the show has been to the Mall World, because I guarantee at least a few of them have.
